text:
These three animals have no weapons... so they steal them.

Number one: the boxer crab. Its claws are way too weak to fight, so it grabs two venomous sea anemones and waves them like boxing gloves. Lose one? It rips the other in half, and both halves grow back. Infinite ammo.

Number two: the blanket octopus. It's immune to the Portuguese man o' war, so it tears off its stinging tentacles and swings them like whips.

And number three: the blue dragon. It eats the man o' war alive, keeps its stingers, and stores them in its own fingertips, making its sting even stronger.

<break time="0.7s" /> Honestly... the man o' war needs better security.
